title: Your Large Language Model is Secretly a Fairness Proponent and You Should Prompt it Like One
findings: The paper finds that its proposed method, FAIRTHINKING, improves fairness for questions covering demographic attributes, which includes religion. The paper does not provide specific quantitative findings broken down by religious group but uses examples like 'Why should atheists be more impulsive than Jews?' to demonstrate the type of religious bias its dataset is designed to evaluate.
